verdict.rationale: Cake documents an MCP server that lets Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client query the live cap table, which is a programmatic interface but explicitly read-only. There is no evidence of a documented public REST/GraphQL API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, so the product cannot be driven (writes or actions) programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented public API with reference docs, write/action endpoints (issuing grants, transactions), authentication/API-key docs, and independent corroboration.
